paper.title: Dependable Long-Horizon LLM Agents: A Trajectory-Centered Empirical Study of Where Errors Enter and Which Controls Reach Them

paper.use: METHOD ONLY: the idea that contradicting evidence already present in a trajectory must be acted on, and that a flag is not a response unless the deviated state is removed. The PDF was not read. The 95-run annotation was not reproduced.

empirical_claims.note: The authors' own figures, quoted verbatim from the arXiv abstract (each quote is an exact substring of the abstract). Not checked, reproduced or re-claimed by this sketch. They appear only in this file.

claims.about: share of failed runs whose trajectory already held evidence against the error before the failure
claims.quote: In 72% of failed runs the trajectory already contained evidence against the error before the failure

claims.about: share of those runs in which no agent acted on that evidence
claims.quote: in 88% of those no agent acted on it.

claims.about: share of runs where a deviation was flagged but no response removed the deviated state
claims.quote: Something flagged a deviation in 31% of runs, but no response removed the deviated state.

claims.about: runs where restoring the agent's own state would have sufficed
claims.quote: restoring the agent's own state would have sufficed in 35 of 95 runs.

claims.about: share of hand-crafted Who&When failures ending in a provider content-filter crash
claims.quote: A text scan of the raw corpus also shows that 45% of the hand-crafted Who&When failures ended with a provider content-filter crash after which the harness emitted a final answer no agent produced

claims.about: motivation: symptom labels do not say where the error entered or whether the trajectory contradicted it
claims.quote: It does not say where the error entered, which state carried it to the symptom, whether anything in the trajectory contradicted it, or which control could have caught it.

claims.about: the only code statement on the abs page; not a repository URL
claims.quote: Protocol, records and scripts are included.

not_results_of_this_sketch: All episodes, labels and outcomes here are synthetic, hand-declared fixtures. The success counts printed by fixtures.py describe that fixture grid and three hand-written policies only; they say nothing about any agent, corpus or the paper's study.
